text:
lina_cs: FYI — AeroInsight onboarding requests an Osaka edge allowlist + transient rate bump for a partner showcase Friday 2026-05-07 11:00 JST. Estimate ~2k calls over 30m. Also renewal flag: low prod usage the past 40d.
ashley_net: Got it. Do they have fixed egress IPs or should we do header-based allowlist?
tomo_aero: hi all, we can provide a CIDR block and will attach headers as fallback. CIDR: 203.0.115.0/27. Traffic from osaka-staging cluster.
miguel_ops: Thanks. For the transient bump I need exact start/end, burst vs sustained qps, and p95 latency target. Also confirm scope = jp-osaka edge only?
tomo_aero: Start 2026-05-07T11:00:00+09:00, duration ~35m. Burst to 110 req/s, sustained ~45 req/s. p95 target <160ms. Scope: osaka-edge only.
lina_cs: Noting renewal context — renewal in ~5w, minimal prod activity last 6 weeks. CS will do an enablement touch after demo; want to capture feedback and offer a playbook.
ashley_net: I'll draft a temp allowlist rule scoped to jp-osaka with auto-expire + auto-revoke. Miguel — prefer we also configure fallback routing and prefix cache?
miguel_ops: Yes. Auto-expire rule, ticketed. Configure fallback to route to model-compact if p95 > 275ms for 60s. Enable prefix KV caching for demo prefix to reduce token spend.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-6001: "AeroInsight JP-OSAKA allowlist + transient bump" (expires 2026-05-07T12:00:00+09:00). Assigned miguel_ops.
lina_cs: Please add a feedback capture step: quick NPS + 3-question follow-up. Also schedule 1:1 if demo meets expectations. Mark renewal status = "at-risk, outreach scheduled".
miguel_ops: Will push rule to jp-osaka-edge (allow CIDR + header pair). Adding header whitelist values: `X-RW-CUSTOMER: aeroinsight-demo`, `X-RW-DEMO: true`. Rule will auto-expire and auto-revoke. Fallback route to `model-compact` on latency breach. Prefix cache warmed for `aeroinsight/stage`.
tomo_aero: Thanks — can you confirm the header format we'll send?
ashley_net: Use exactly those two headers and include `x-rw-demo-id: ai-osaka-1` for quick tracing. We'll accept either CIDR or header pair.
miguel_ops: Rule applied to osaka-edge, caching enabled, fallback route configured. Instrumented an eval endpoint with tags `cs:aeroinsight demo:osaka`. Ticket CS-6001 updated with links to logs and a pre-demo smoke checklist.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 30 minutes before start to #cs-oncall and the assigned owner.
lina_cs: I'll prepare the enablement one-pager and the post-demo survey; adding checklist items in CS notes: demo outcome, p95, error rate, ask for committed usage.
tomo_aero: We'll run a smoke test at 10:20 JST and post results here. Appreciate the fast turn-around! :pray:
